Hold.description: Why a task is held, and at most one condition that releases it. With none, a person does.

after.description: Another task's id: the hold lasts until it ends.

blockers.description: Until the task's Linear issue has no open blocker.

if_closed.description: What a pull request closed without a merge does: `release`, `drop` or `ask`, the default.

merge.description: A pull request, `owner/name#42` or `42` in the task's repository: until it merges.

reason.description: Why the task waits, shown to a person.

until.description: An RFC 3339 instant, or a duration such as `2 hours` after the hold.

description:
`triggers/<name>.toml` or `.yaml`: an event source, its filter and the workflow its events
start. The file name is the trigger's name.

at.description: The local time of day a schedule fires, `HH:MM`.

backfill.description: Whether the events of the first poll start tasks too.

channel.description: The Slack channel id a `slack` trigger reads, such as `C0123`.

days.description: The weekdays a schedule fires on; every day when unset.

every.description: How often a schedule fires again after `at`, the same day; once a day when unset.

filter.description:
Values an event must have: `label` for GitHub; `team`, `label`, `state` for Linear; `text`
for Slack.

hold.description: Files each task held, so it waits for a person or a condition before it starts.

key.description: Which events are the same work, such as `issue.number`; for a schedule, a fixed key.

lane.description: The lane of its tasks, `<team>/<theme>`; `lanes.toml` derives it when unset.

on.description: The event that starts a task, such as `issues.labeled`; depends on `source`.

prompt.description: What a schedule's firing tells the task it wakes.

repo.description: The repository the trigger's tasks work in, `owner/name`; the polled one for `github`.

timezone.description: The IANA zone `at` is read in, such as `Europe/Paris`; the machine's own when unset.

until.description: When a schedule's day of firings ends; the end of the day when unset.

view.description: The saved Linear view a `linear.view` trigger reads: its id, or the slug id ending its URL.

workflow.description: The workflow a matching event starts, by file name.

title: trigger
